scenario: No free-text attribute errors on consolidated trauma findings
description: Stage 3b call built from abdomen-ct/findings_gt/example_2.json and findings_pred/example_2.json. The adductor hematoma is one finding with its bleeding focus (slow active bleeding versus pseudoaneurysm) on each side and aligns cleanly. The prior hematoma size the texts quote (9 x 5 cm) is carried by `comparison` ('improving'), not by `measurements`. None of the attribute dimensions apply to the matched pairs.

pred_finding.text: Left adductor intramuscular hematoma measuring 7 x 4.7 cm (decreased from 9 x 5 cm on prior exam) with a small 6 mm central focus of hyperdensity on early-phase imaging that did not persist on delayed imaging: slow active bleeding versus pseudoaneurysm.
